changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Reference_All] AS select A.ID as AssetID, ATT.Name as ReferenceItemType, ATT.ObjectID as ReferenceItemTypeID, A.ObjectID as ReferenceItemID, A.Code, AD.DisplayValue, A.CreatedBy, A.CreatedOn, A.UpdatedBy, A.UpdatedOn from Asset A inner join AssetType ATT on (A.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID) inner join AssetDisplayValue AD on (A.ID = AD.AssetID) where ATT.Class = 9 and A.State = 1
